title: Administrator checks
description: m9 §17.2 / §17.6 administrator checks on the host: a request (the waiting run_diagnostic calls of one turn with an admin-tier id; a paired window's calls join the task's open request until it is approved), the agent.checks event payload on stream user, and checks.approve / checks.decline / checks.list (desktop only). The root is a request view, as checks.approve and checks.decline return it and agent.checks carries it.

state.description: A request's state and each check operation's (get_operation answers the same; complete, as long diagnostics).

code.description: Why it ended this way. cancelled: permissions (a narrowing), ai (the chosen AI changed), task_ended, admin_unavailable, exhausted, stopped. declined: user_declined (in the app), uac_cancelled, broker_cancelled (the helper's Cancel). failed: timeout, malformed, interrupted, the helper's refusal (different_admin, bad_nonce, …) or the host's not-started code (broker_missing, broker_not_started, …). null otherwise.

revision.description: Bumped when a check joins. checks.approve must send it (stale: -32002 {reason: stale_revision, current}). Membership is frozen once approved.

cardId.description: The card of the fix attempt whose turn asked, or null.

retryAt.description: While waiting: when the 60 s cooldown after a decline or cancel ends (ISO 8601 UTC), else null. checks.approve before then: -32013 {reason: cooldown, retryAt}.

expiresAt.description: A request waits 10 minutes for the user, then it is expired.

label.description: The host's label (AdminChecks.HostLabel), e.g. "Defender detection history · last 30 days".

approveParams.description: checks.approve → the request (running). Only an awaiting request (else -32013 with its state as reason); the host rechecks the task, the grant (checks and admin), the flag and the budget first and otherwise cancels it with that code.

declineParams.description: checks.decline → the request (declined, code user_declined); the cooldown starts. Only an awaiting request (else -32013 with its state).

listResult.description: checks.list → every request that has not ended (awaiting_user, including one waiting out the cooldown with retryAt, and running), oldest first, as agent.checks carries them: the app shows them again after a reload.

toolWaiting.description: run_diagnostic with an admin-tier id: the check waits for the user (or is already running, when asked again).
